_about: Controlled vocabulary for relating inspiration sites to each other. These four dimensions are the ONLY graph-forming tags in the vault. Single source of truth for the enricher (classifies new sites), the backfill classifier, and render_vault. Values may be added sparingly, only when nothing fits; every value should plausibly apply to several sites.

vertical._rule: What the site IS. Pick exactly ONE (the closest).
vertical.portfolio: personal portfolio / creative-developer showcase; the person's work is the content
vertical.personal-blog: writing-first personal site; essays, notes, a person's thinking
vertical.startup-product: company or product marketing site: SaaS landing, app launch, startup homepage
vertical.tool-app: an interactive tool or utility you USE in the browser (editor, generator, dashboard)
vertical.studio-agency: design/dev studio or agency site selling services
vertical.ecommerce: storefront selling physical or digital goods
vertical.publication-newsletter: editorial publication, magazine, or newsletter home
vertical.directory-gallery: curated collection of other things: inspiration galleries, link directories, moodboards
vertical.docs-resource: documentation, course, tutorial hub, or reference resource
vertical.experiment-art: art piece, interactive toy, generative experiment; exists to be experienced
vertical.community-social: community, forum, social platform, or event site

vibe._rule: How the site FEELS. Pick 1-3 that genuinely dominate.
vibe.minimal: restrained, whitespace-led, few elements, quiet type
vibe.editorial: magazine/print sensibility: serif display, columns, article-like rhythm
vibe.playful: toy-like, rounded, animated personality, humor, delight details
vibe.brutalist: raw, unpolished-on-purpose, default-ish HTML, harsh contrasts
vibe.retro: nostalgic: old-OS chrome, pixel art, vaporwave, y2k, print-era artifacts
vibe.luxury: expensive, cinematic, full-bleed photography, fashion-house restraint
vibe.corporate-clean: polished conventional SaaS/product look: tidy grid, gradient accents, safe
vibe.organic-warm: cream/paper textures, hand-made feel, soft warm palettes, human touch
vibe.technical: dev-tool aesthetic: monospace, terminal vibes, dense information, dark IDE energy

topic._rule: What the site is ABOUT (subject matter). 0-3 values; this bridges clusters (a personal blog ABOUT startups links to the startup world). Omit if no clear subject.
topic.startups: startup life, founding, venture, indie hacking
topic.design: design itself: UI/UX, typography, design tools and writing about design
topic.writing: writing, reading, books, essays as a subject

mode._rule: Dominant color mode. Pick ONE (or 'mixed' if genuinely split).
